# porch_application (Resource)

An application of a tenant: an OpenID Connect client (`kind = "oidc"`) or a forward-auth protected web app (`kind = "forward_auth"`). Needs `app:manage` in the tenant. The client secret of confidential OIDC clients is returned by Porch only once, at creation; it is kept in state (sensitive) and never re-read. Change `secret_version` to rotate it. Import with `<tenant>/<application_id>` (the secret is then unknown until rotated).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An OpenID Connect client.
resource "porch_application" "jellyfin" {
  tenant     = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  slug       = "jellyfin"
  name       = "Jellyfin"
  kind       = "oidc"
  launch_url = "https://jellyfin.smith.example"

  disclosure = {
    groups = true
  }

  client = {
    redirect_uris  = ["https://jellyfin.smith.example/sso/OID/redirect/porch"]
    grant_types    = ["authorization_code", "refresh_token"]
    allowed_scopes = ["openid", "profile", "email", "groups"]
  }

  # Bump to rotate the client secret.
  secret_version = "1"
}

# A web app protected by Porch's forward-auth outpost.
resource "porch_application" "whoami" {
  tenant      = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  slug        = "whoami"
  name        = "Whoami"
  kind        = "forward_auth"
  access_mode = "assigned"
  hosts       = ["whoami.smith.example"]

  forward_headers = {
    "X-User"   = "sub"
    "X-Email"  = "email"
    "X-Family" = "tenant"
  }
}

output "jellyfin_client_id" {
  value = porch_application.jellyfin.client_id
}

output "jellyfin_client_secret" {
  value     = porch_application.jellyfin.client_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) `oidc` or `forward_auth`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Display name (shown in the launcher).
- `slug` (String) Identifier, unique in the tenant. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `tenant` (String) ID or slug of the tenant that owns this object. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `access_mode` (String) `all_members` (default: every active member of the tenant and of tenants it is shared with) or `assigned` (explicit `app:access` grants only).
- `client` (Attributes) OIDC client configuration; required for `kind = "oidc"`, not allowed for `forward_auth`. Updates replace the whole client configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--client))
- `description` (String) Description.
- `disclosure` (Attributes) Optional claims released to the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disclosure))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the application accepts sign-ins. Default `true`.
- `forward_headers` (Map of String) Identity headers sent to forward-auth backends (header name → `sub`, `email`, `name`, `groups`, `tenant` or `roles`); empty uses Porch's defaults.
- `hosts` (Set of String) Hosts protected by a `forward_auth` application (at least one; lowercase). Must be empty for `oidc`.
- `launch_url` (String) URL the launcher opens (http/https).
- `secret_version` (String) Arbitrary value; changing it (including setting it for the first time, e.g. after an import) rotates the client secret and stores the new one. The old secret stops working immediately.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) OAuth client ID (`oidc` only).
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret of a confidential OIDC client. Only known after create (or rotation); never re-read.
- `discovery_url` (String) OIDC discovery document URL (`oidc` only).
- `id` (String) Application ID (`app_…`).
- `issuer` (String) OIDC issuer (`oidc` only).

<a id="nestedatt--client"></a>
### Nested Schema for `client`

Optional:

- `access_token_ttl_seconds` (Number) Access token lifetime (60..3600, default 600).
- `allowed_origins` (Set of String) Browser origins allowed to call the token endpoint (SPA clients).
- `allowed_scopes` (Set of String) Scopes the client may request (default `openid profile email offline_access`).
- `application_type` (String) `web` (default), `native` or `user_agent`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `audiences` (Set of String) API audiences access tokens may be issued for (RFC 8707).
- `client_type` (String) `confidential` (default) or `public`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `grant_types` (Set of String) `authorization_code` (default), `refresh_token`, `client_credentials`.
- `id_token_ttl_seconds` (Number) ID token lifetime (60..3600, default 600).
- `post_logout_redirect_uris` (Set of String) Post-logout redirect URIs.
- `redirect_uris` (Set of String) Exact redirect URIs (https, or http on loopback).
- `refresh_idle_seconds` (Number) Refresh token idle timeout (3600..refresh_ttl_seconds, default 1209600).
- `refresh_ttl_seconds` (Number) Refresh token lifetime (3600..31536000, default 2592000).
- `require_pkce` (Boolean) Require PKCE (default `true`; always true for public clients).
- `signing_alg` (String) ID token signing algorithm: `ES256` (default) or `RS256`.


<a id="nestedatt--disclosure"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disclosure`

Optional:

- `email` (Boolean) Release the email (default `true`).
- `entitlements` (Boolean) Release entitlements (default `false`).
- `groups` (Boolean) Release groups (default `false`).
- `roles` (Boolean) Release roles (default `true`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porch_application.jellyfin <tenant>/<application_id>   # the client secret is unknown until rotated
```
